sana_eval: quick note — during mortar-v1 q3 bringup we observed a reproducible detok-glue on mixed han+kana sequences. BLEU zh->en -1.9, ja->en -1.2 vs fp16. sample below.

hiroshi_onboard: paste run + sample pls

sana_eval: run id 2026-04-02-mortar-q3-glue. model mortar-v1, quant=q3 dynamic per-tensor, kernels=auto, tokenizer v2026-03-10. evalset: mixed-orient-mini (1.5k pairs). sample:
```
input: "\u65e5\u672c\u306e\u8a9e\u53e5\u4e2d\u306b\u6f22\u5b57\u306e\u6307\u5b9a\u304c\u3042\u308a\u307e\u3059"
fp16: "There are kanji markers inside the Japanese sentence."
q3: "There arekanji markers inside the Japanese sentence."
```

adrien_research: looks like token boundary collapse (no space) at han->kana frontier. tokenizer.roundtrip ok?

sana_eval: yes token ids match. issue occurs only on generated outputs. reproduced on GPU and local CPU.

ops_dan: try forcing fp16 accumulation and kv as quick check: RT_ACCUM_FP16=true RT_KV_FP16=true

sana_eval: tried that. BLEU recovered to -0.3 and sample detok fixed. latency +8ms.

adrien_research: likely numeric drift in KV/accum path causing soft-shift in token probs on short-prefix subtokens. please capture kv dumps + logits and attach to MR #4712.

ci-bot: CI run started for 2026-04-02-mortar-q3-glue (#3580).

hiroshi_onboard: adding a temporary Optimize rule: for datasets tagged with ja/zh/kr, recommend "kv_fp16=true" until kernel patch lands.

sana_eval: PR with fuzz cases added. will follow up in MR and the ticket. :thumbsup:
